2608.14380.title: AgentRewind: Recoverable Execution for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
2608.14380.paper_summary: Many real-world tasks require LLM agents to interact with their environments over long execution horizons. Errors that occur early in execution may propagate through both the agent context and environment state, and their effects may be difficult to reverse through subsequent actions. Existing methods mainly seek to reduce such errors through plan refinement and safety checks but provide little support after errors occur. To enable recovery during long-horizon execution, we present AgentRewind, a runtime recovery framework that records aligned checkpoints of the agent context and controlled environment, allowing agents to return to an earlier state and resume execution with information from previous attempts. We also construct MettleBench, a benchmark for evaluating task completion and partial progress on long-horizon engineering assignments containing a series of related requirements. Experiments across tasks, multiple models, execution strategies, and agent harnesses show that AgentRewind improves task success rate and average checklist progress over the compared baselines.
2608.14380.paper_summary_zh: 許多現實世界的任務需要 LLM 代理在長期執行的過程中與其環境互動。<lb/>在執行過程中早期發生的錯誤可能會在代理上下文和環境狀態中傳播，其影響可能難以通過後續行動逆轉。<lb/>現有的方法主要通過計劃精煉和安全檢查來減少這些錯誤，但在錯誤發生後提供的支持有限。<lb/>為了在長期執行過程中實現恢復，我們提出了 AgentRewind，一個運行時恢復框架，該框架記錄代理上下文和受控環境的對齊檢查點，允許代理返回到早期狀態並利用先前嘗試的信息重新開始執行。<lb/>我們還構建了 MettleBench，一個基準，用於評估在包含一系列相關要求的長期工程任務中的任務完成和部分進展。<lb/>在多個任務、模型、執行策略和代理裝置上的實驗顯示，AgentRewind 提高了任務成功率和平均檢查清單進展，相較於基準線有明顯改善。
